content:
Gus: Heads up 4 our new Director, ML Infrastructure, starts Monday. Can we assemble a short manager+HR checklist, a one-paragraph welcome blurb for the offer, and a compact 30/60/90 outcomes list? Also who to loop in for building badge, GitHub org, and KMS access?

Rina: Congrats! Short checklist (copyable):
- Preboard (Day -3 to 0): confirm laptop spec + courier, Okta invite, Slack + GitHub org invite, calendar "Welcome" block
- Day 1 AM: People Ops welcome (payroll, benefits, legal forms) (20m)
- Day 1 mid: Manager welcome (role context + immediate priorities) (30m)
- Day 1 PM: IT & access sweep (GitHub org, VPN, Okta, CI tokens) (30m)
- Day 2: Pair with assigned buddy for dev env + run smoke test (2h)
- Day 3: Security primer + KMS/process checklist (30m)
- Week 1: schedule 1:1s with direct reports and key partners; end-week 30m readout (blockers & 30-day goals)

Rina: Who to ping: badge/parking -> Facilities (cc Ollie), GitHub org & repo invites -> eng-admin or @Priya, KMS/VPN -> #security-ops or Rina. For payroll/forms -> people-ops@redwood.com.

Ollie: Facilities note: if onsite any week, give me preferred days and phone number and I9ll reserve a QR desk pass + parking (if needed). For international hires we can pre-order eSIM.

Priya: Security heads-up  for KMS we require a signed AUP + manager approval. I can pre-stage a short-lived role for dev verification once I get approval. Recommend a 30-min security primer in week 1 and a follow-up to request any elevated access.

Gus: Can you draft the one-paragraph candidate-facing blurb? Keep it calm and concise.

Rina: Paste this: "Welcome week (brief): Day 1 includes People Ops onboarding and a manager welcome, followed by an IT/access sweep and a relaxed team lunch. Day 2 youll pair with your assigned buddy to set up your dev environment and run a smoke test. Day 3 has a short security and infra orientation. Days 45 are reserved for a small hands-on task (first PR or infra tweak) and initial 1:1s. We finish the week with a 30-minute sync with your manager to align on 30-day priorities."

Priya: 30/60/90 outcomes to include in offer email (short bullets):
- 30 days: full access to core tools, first small change merged, 1:1 cadence established and documented onboarding notes
- 60 days: owning a small infra project (spec -> deploy), runbooks improved and baseline metrics captured
- 90 days: leading a cross-team initiative, measurable impact on infra reliability or cost, mentoring plan in place

Ollie: Facilities queued the QR pass for the first two onsite days. I9ll DM for phone and address.

Rina: For the onboarding task: clone repo, run `./ci/smoke.sh` (no secrets), update a README or small script, open PR. Validates permissions without touching keys.

HR Bot: New hire created: "Director, ML Infrastructure  start 2026-05-11". Onboarding tasks assigned to Gus (manager), Rina (security), Ollie (facilities), Priya (eng-admin). Welcome email scheduled. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/MLD-3001

Gus: Thanks all. I9ll add the candidate handle here and send the signed AUP if KMS access becomes necessary. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
